City Council Meeting
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA City Council Meeting
May 23, 2017 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
6.1
PROCLAMATION FOR OLDER AMERICANS MONTH – It is recommended the City Council proclaim May 2017 as Older Americans Month in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Senior Council Member Peggy Roman.
Item 6.1 Proclamation
6.2.
RECOGNITION OF LA MIRADA HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS FOR ACADEMIC ACHIEVEMENT – It is recommended the City Council recognize the top senior scholars at La Mirada High School for their outstanding academic achievement and present them with a Certificate of Recognition.
Item 6.2 Recognition of La Mirada High School Students
6.3
PRESENTATION OF AWARDS TO LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION SCHOLARSHIP RECIPIENTS – It is recommended the City Council present Certificates of Recognition, and the Board of Directors of the La Mirada Community Foundation present scholarship checks in the amount of $1,000 to Miriam Adhanom, Emma Schween and Thomas Valles, and in the amount of $1,250 to Jordan Sullivan and Leland Wilcox.
Item 6.3 Presentation of Scholarships

RECOGNITION OF EMPLOYEES FOR YEARS OF SERVICE â€“ It is recommended the City Council recognize Paul Castillo, Devis Andrade and Mark Veitch for their years of service and present them with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.

CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2016-10, SANTA GERTRUDES AVENUE WALL AND PARKWAY IMPROVEMENTS FROM ROSECRANS AVENUE TO ALICANTE ROAD â€“ REVIEW OF BIDS AND AWARD OF CONTRACT - It is recommended the City Council award the contract for Capital Improvement Project No. 2016-10, Santa Gertrudes Avenue Wall and Parkway Improvements from Rosecrans Avenue to Alicante Road, to E.C. Construction, Inc. in the amount of $1,327,687.52; authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; authorize the City Manager to approve addendums to the existing on-call engineering contracts for construction inspection, survey and testing services in an amount not to exceed 20 percent of the construction; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional work up to 20 percent of the total project cost including construction, construction survey, testing and inspection.

RESOLUTION NO. 17-15 AUTHORIZING THE PROHIBITION OF PARKING ON THE EAST SIDE OF LA MIRADA BOULEVARD'S WEST FRONTAGE ROAD BETWEEN TACUBA DRIVE AND VALEDA DRIVE - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-15 authorizing the prohibition of parking on the east side of La Mirada Boulevard's west frontage road between Tacuba Drive and Valeda Drive.
Item 9.1 Resolution No. 17-15

RESOLUTION NO. 17-16 GRANTING CONSENT AND JURISDICTION TO THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES IN THE MATTER OF COUNTY LIGHTING MAINTENANCE DISTRICT 10045 AND COUNTY LIGHTING DISTRICT LANDSCAPING AND LIGHTING ACT-1, PARCEL MAP 73574 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-16 granting consent and jurisdiction to the County of Los Angeles in the matter of transferring the area within the subject lighting districts.
Item 9.2 Resolution No. 17-16
